nom: e.l.f. Cosmetics Glass Slick Serum Stick - Bounce + Plump Peptide Blend

avis.texte: I love how this stick goes on to your skin. It feels very light weight and you can apply before you do your makeup or after. Definitely recommend!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Really happy with my ELF purchase! The product is great quality, looks lovely, and works really well. It arrived well packaged and was exactly as described. Very happy with my order and would definitely buy again. Highly recommended! ❤️
I received this product to give a honest review. I have combination skin, this helps even that out a bit and prevents creasing! I love the feeling it gives almost a cool like feeling.

I was annoyed with this stick. I did not like using a stick with "serum" , and putting it on that way. I saw no difference and could not even tell this was on my skin. Maybe my skin is too dehydrated, but I was looking forward to this , as this is a cool concept. But I am pretty disappointed. The product container is pretty however. Maybe it would be better to try in the winter time?

I got this product, and my first immediate reaction is that I love the packaging. It's small, but the stick feels like it has a significant amount of product in it, considering how expensive it is. I think that's great. It also just slides on really well, and I feel like the claims about it giving a "glow skin" effect aren't really what happened. It does have a protective cap, which I think helps—so if you lose the lid or something, you still have a way to protect it and keep it uniform. Essentially, I feel like it doesn't really have any particular scent, which I actually prefer, and I feel like my skin absorbs it pretty easily. I do live in a dry climate, so maybe that's part of it, but I don't feel like it actually makes my skin more bouncy or plump. I feel like maybe the intention would be that if I used it consistently—like I have for about three or four days in a row—it would have some sort of impact. But it also leaves a residue on my fingers when I rub it in, and I need to wash it off. I don't love that.

I really want to like this item, and it's probably a great product. Just doesn't go with my skin very well, I tried it a few different ways. With moisturizer, with makeup, without, skin starts out looks dewy and glassy, but after an hour It was just very oily looking.

This product was gifted by Elf in exchange for my honest opinion. Have combination skin but leans more on the oily side. I like how it makes my skin feels. It glides so well on my skin. Giving me a radiant and glowy look.
It's so smooth, easy to include in my routine. After my face feels plump and lovely
Product did not seem to make a difference on my combination skin. Packaging and application are all very good, but this product is not for me.

I have to say I am disappointed in this product, I love elf products, I have many, I buy many, I buy them regularly, but this one especially for the price just is not at all as described. It leaves like an oily feel on your face, even if you use very little of it. It doesn't give your face the glass look it looks oily. It feels just like the holy hydration makeup primer stick only with oil. It's not worth that much money to get it and then it not be as described. It says in the description that it is not oily and doesn't feel oily but yet it is and it does. I hate leaving any kind of bad or negative reviews I try to be kind about it and I am always 100% honest and when I leave reviews I want whom ever else is interested in a product that I have had and tried myself to know my experience with it. I rely heavily on reviews when ordering things offline. 🤷🏼‍♀️🙅🏼‍♀️🤦🏼‍♀️

I just love this serum stick so much - it goes on so smooth and slick, like water. I use it a few different ways as it's pretty versatile. When I apply it after cleansing my face at night, it makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated. When I'm not wearing makeup, I use it to give my face a dewy, refreshed glow. I put it under my eyes, above my cheekbones, and a little on my forehead and nose. I like applying it over my makeup sometimes as well; all it takes are a few dabs on my cheeks and I rub the serum upward and outward. It gives me such a fresh, glassy glow. I will definitely be getting more before I run out!
Buy now!! Love it so much such a beautiful color my favorite getting more forsure

avis.titre: Stops dry skin and gives glassy skin
avis.texte: I love this serum stick. I use it as a highlighter over my makeup and keep it in my purse to touch up dry spots throughout the day. There's no scent and no glitter so it's a natural radiance that makes my skin look healthy and hydrated.
Crazy good product! Easy to apply, absorbs like a dream, and gives me a shiny reflection. PERFECTION!

I received this product for free in exchange for a review through BzzAgent. I honestly did not love. It left my skin feeling really oily. Im seeing other people say they really liked when they put it in the fridge, so I will try that next. I will say it did absorb into the skin nicely. If you have dryer skin, this would be a good product but as an oily girl it wasn't for me
I absolutely loved this free product! It made my skin look amazing! I would recommend using for that glass skin look. I used it alone and also with foundation. Will definitely be buying in store.

I received elf glass stick serum complimentary from BzzAgent. I've really been enjoying the e.l.f. Glass Stick Serum. It's incredibly easy to apply, and the stick format is mess-free and convenient for quick touch-ups. It glides smoothly over my skin and gives an instant healthy, dewy glow without feeling sticky or greasy. It also feels lightweight and hydrating, making my skin look fresh throughout the day.

I got a sample of this Glass Slick Serum Stick to review. I wore it under my vitamin C and E moisturizer. It didn't feel heavy or oily; instead, it left my skin smooth and supple. It also gave me a nice, healthy glow. It was comfortable to wear during the day and night, and I found it easy to apply. I had a good experience with it and would probably use it again.

Ive received this product through BzzAgent sampling program but they don't pay me to say I like it, so here's the truth: The first thing that caught my attention was the format. I love that it's bar ("stick") because it's super practical and quick to use. As it says in the instructions I saw on the web, just swipe it up your face after cleaning and toning. You don't need to use your hands to apply it, which I find great and more hygienic. I've been using it both just for a natural "no-makeup" look and underneath my base. It works wonderly as a moisturizing base; it makes makeup apply more gently and last longer without cluttering dry areas. The only "thing" I find is that, being a bar product that you apply directly to your skin, if you have active imperfections, it could transfer bacteria back to the stick. I recommend cleaning the tip after each use if you're in a breakout. Other than that, I think it's a product! It's affordable, effective, and super practical. I'll definitely keep using it and buy it when I run out!

I received this product as part of a campaign. I've promised to leave an honest review. I'm somewhat hesitant to try new skincare products as I've grown accustomed to what works for me at this stage of my life. When I saw that this product had a plumping effect, that really caused me to hesitate as my face is pretty firm and toned as is, if you catch my drift. 😆 The application was smooth and glided on so easily. There was also little to no smell which is in line with their clean skincare claims. I used it after applying my toner. Nothing else. I don't like to apply a lot of heavy products to my face. I woke up to my face still feeling moisturized when I would usually feel slightly dry. I didn't even have to apply more that morning. I still felt fresh after washing again.

I've used my current skincare regime for several months and I'm kind of nervous to try anything that mentions plumping effects as my face is pretty firm and plump as is, if you catch my drift. The application was so smooth and lightweight. Their was little to no smell which works so well for me and follows in line with their clean skincare. I used it after toning my face in place of my regular serum. No other moisturizer to follow. I don't like a lot of heavy products at night before going to bed. When I woke up the next morning, my face still felt so moisturized! Usually my face would feel somewhat dry from my normal products. It didn't feel heavy or anything but there was a noticeable difference. I was converted after the first application!

I received this product as a gift in exchange for my honest opinion. I've incorporated it into my skincare routine over the past couple of months and have definitely noticed a difference. Immediately after application, my skin has a natural glow and looks more luminous. I also love how lightweight the serum stick feels because it layers well without feeling greasy or heavy. Over time, I've noticed that my skin feels more hydrated, especially when I apply the serum stick before my moisturizer. I'll definitely be purchasing it once I run out. It's an effective product at a great price point, which is one of the reasons I love e.l.f. Cosmetics!
I have really enjoyed this serum stick. Looks great under makeup but also alone. Easy to use and leaves a nice light glow on your skin.

I have several serum sticks and this one is just as effective as the much higher end ones. It's moisturizing without feeling to heavy. It will be nice to have in my bag as the weather gets colder and my skin feels dry throughout the day. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Looks good by itself or under makeup
avis.texte: Been using this product for several weeks now and happy with how it looks under my light summer makeup routine, it does not feel heavy and adds a nice natural glow without looking oily or shiny. Will continue to use and happy with it so far! E.L.F. sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program.

avis.titre: if i was stranded on an island this would be my item
avis.texte: I've used this a couple times now and i am OBSESSED !! It's so versatile and great to travel with! It works amazing as a serum it gives a cooling effect, it also looks very wet when applied as a highlighter on top of your makeup ! so so glowy

avis.titre: Versatile Glow in a Convenient Stick
avis.texte: I received the e.l.f. Skin Glass Slick Serum Stick for free in exchange for an honest review. I really enjoyed using this product! It gives my skin a healthy, dewy glow without feeling heavy or greasy. One of my favorite things about it is how versatile it is—I used it on the high points of my face for a natural highlight, but it also worked well to add radiance anywhere my skin looked a little dull. The stick format makes it quick, mess-free, and perfect for touch-ups throughout the day. If you're looking for an easy way to achieve a fresh, glowy complexion, this is definitely worth trying.
To be completely honest, not my favorite. I feel like it leaves my face oily.

avis.titre: Does what it promises, but not quite for me.
avis.texte: ☆☆ I received this product for free with my promise of a honest review. The e.l.f. Skin Glass Stick definitely delivers on its main promise—it gives your skin a gorgeous, healthy-looking sheen. Plus, the stick format makes it effortless to swipe on, and I really appreciated that it's completely fragrance-free. However, the formula feels a bit heavy and left my skin feeling greasy rather than refreshed. I was also a bit confused about where it fits into a routine—is it skincare, or is it makeup? Since it sits a little heavy on my face, I'm just not sure this product is the right fit for my skin type.

Glass skin but make it convenient and easy to achieve. I have super sensitive skin and this actually didn't break me out. Only eating 4 out of 5 since I haven't used it long enough to see how my skin responds. Elf sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program.
I got this as a free trial. I love the way it makes my skin feel. I recommend it to all my friends and family looking to try new products.
I liked the glass stick. It did not make my combination skin oily at all. It makes me face glow. It is not at all sticky. It does not leave a film on your face. (This review is a part of a promotion)

avis.titre: I love the way it feels on my skin
avis.texte: I use this at night with the bluey night oil and my skin looks amazing

I prefer this over the Chanel balm stick! The ELF stick is lighter weight and since it is skincare rather than makeup, I don't mind sleeping it (unlike Chanel). I've also used it under makeup and it works nicely. 10/10 I got this product free in exchange for my honest review, but would repurchase
I really enjoyed using the Glass Slick Serum Stick. It left my face feeling incredibly smooth and gave my skin a glass-like, radiant look. Definitely a product to keep in my routine!

I received this product for free as part of a campaign and it's been good so far! I've never used a serum stick before, and I really like how easy to use it is. You can use a little or a lot, depending on the look you are going for. I like to use it as one of the first products I put on, before my makeup. I liked the slight glossiness it gave to my skin.

I've been pleasantly surprised by the Glass Slick Serum Stick. It's incredibly convenient to use, especially when I'm on the go, and it leaves my skin looking smooth with a healthy, natural glow instead of feeling greasy. What I liked most is that it glides on easily and doesn't feel heavy or sticky. It works well for quick touch-ups throughout the day and gives my skin a refreshed appearance. A couple of takeaways: if you have very oily skin, you may want to use it sparingly since a little goes a long way. Also, the stick format is great for portability, but I wish there were a bit more product in the tube for the price. Overall, it's a quality product that delivers on its promise. I'd definitely recommend it to anyone looking for an easy way to add hydration and a subtle, glass-skin finish to their routine.

I am probably not the demographic for this product as I'm 41 years old and not really into the glass skin look. However, I love to use this item as an illuminating primer. It really makes liquid and powder foundations glide on effortlessly. It gives a nice, subtle lit from with glow that I definitely want to achieve. I received this product for free in exchange for writing the review.

After using the glass slick serum i can say it adds very subtle shine if you're looking for something more toned down for everyday. I was hoping it would be more luminous but this is a nice neutral option. It's like a velvety chalk/powder texture for context. I have very oily skin so I feel like it could last more on someone with less oily skin.
Enjoying it so far! Hydrating and and dewy but not too heavy.

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. I will start by saying when I wear makeup I go for a more natural look. I paired this with my concealer and skin tint and I loved the results. It made my skin look smooth and added some glow to it. It was quick and easy to apply also. I recommend this product for anyone who wants "glass" skin.
This product leaves my skin glowing! I love using it to make a light makeup look stand out and elevate it. It isn't oily or greasy and leaves my skin feeling amazing!

I received this as part of a sample campaign and I've really enjoyed it so far! I love how lightweight it is. I'm very picky about skincare; I don't like heavy creams or serums. I found this to be the perfect balance between hydrating and light. The feature I like the most is that it's a solid formula so it takes me less time in my skincare routine and is more convenient. I'm not sure if my skin *looks* more bouncy but it definitely *feels* more bouncy, hydrated, and healthy.

avis.titre: Looking younger with just a few swipes
avis.texte: I'm 48 and I've had a pretty stressful life, which has been showing on my face. I've been trying a few products to slow the effects. The Glass Serum Stick has been really helpful in my quest to look younger. I swipe some of the stick on my forehead lines and my crows feet, and then I put my moisturizer on top. Easy peasy! The only downside is that when first using it, it'll ball up a little on the skin. But after a few uses, that stops. I'd definitely get it again.

Been into testing all sorts of sticks for my face-especially for my under eyes and temple. The packaging Is absolutely gorgeous. The stick is a great size and goes on very cool and smooth. I'm not 100% sure that it is making my skin look any different, but it feels great and can be worn at night order during the day.

I've tried quite a few makeup products that promise a dewy, glass-skin finish, but the e.l.f. Cosmetics Glass Slick Serum Stick stands out because it gives my skin a healthy glow without feeling greasy or heavy. Unlike some highlighting sticks that leave behind chunky shimmer, this one creates a smooth, natural-looking radiance that works beautifully on both bare skin and over makeup. One of the biggest benefits of owning this product is how convenient it is. The stick packaging makes it easy to throw in a purse for quick touch-ups, and the lightweight serum formula keeps my skin looking fresh and hydrated throughout the day. It's also versatile. I use it on my cheekbones, brow bone, and even on dry areas that need an extra boost of glow. I would absolutely buy this product again. The quality is impressive, especially for the price, and a little goes a long way. It has become a staple in my everyday makeup routine because it's so quick and effortless to apply. I would definitely recommend the e.l.f. Glass Slick Serum Stick to my friends and family. It's perfect for anyone who loves a fresh, radiant complexion without glitter or a heavy feel. Whether you're new to makeup or already have a full collection, this is an affordable product that's worth adding to your routine.

avis.titre: Loving my Glass Slick Serum Stick
avis.texte: I love the glowing effect of the Glass Slick Serum Stick! As someone who wears minimal makeup daily, I feel like this gives me the perfect base layer for a dewy/Glass Skin look!

This is my first time trying a serum stick. I love it! It glides on smoothly, and leaves my skin looking dewy and healthy. It's emollient without being heavy or greasy, and it moisturizes my dry skin. Highly recommend!

I received the glass stick serum for free in exchange for writing a review. I really liked this product. I think it has versatile uses. It gives a glass look for sure. I like it better as a topper than under makeup. I don't wear much makeup during hot summer days and I used it without makeup more. The dewy look without shimmer was nice as a highlighter. Would I buy it? Probably not unless I really find myself using it a lot as a highlighter. I didn't notice any plumping. I didn't love it under my makeup or notice anything that was very different without it. I don't know that I'd recommend it unless someone was looking for a highlighter that wasn't shimmery.
Feels amazing on the skin! Super hydrating and easy to apply! Recommend!

This product says it can be used with/under skincare, but I didn't feel like there was a benefit to this. If anything it felt like I had product trapped under my skin. It's summertime as I'm using this, and I do not feel like the serum itself does anything that sweat won't. I can't say that I would wear it instead of moisturizer either. However! Using this over makeup is great. I've never liked the way highlighter looks, but the Glass Slick gives a really nice and subtle glow over makeup. It didn't rub away my cream based products, and it didn't feel like an extra layer of makeup. I was a big fan of the dewy/glassy finish this gave. Especially with lighter makeup instead of a full-face look. *I did receive this product in exchange for an honest review. This review is based solely on my experience with this product.

I received this for free in exchange for my honest review. I have used the glass stick daily for about two weeks and I love it! I don't like to use a lot of products at once, especially in hot summer weather. I like the smooth feel to my skin with this - it feels hydrating and smoothing without leaving a greasy residue. It has layered well under makeup and it lightweight.I would definitely purchase this again; it is a comparable and quality product, but more economical and accessible on a budget than some competitors.

I've enjoyed trying this out! My skin gets dry often and this made it look visibly more hydrated! It was a little too shiny not just glowy but I plan to continue using it with makeup rather than just all over.

I received this item to try in exchange for my review. I have to say, as someone who has traditionally dry skin and needs something under my moisturizer. This is definitely an affordable and less messy serum to use daily. It is cooling and makes my skin feel soft even before adding my moisturizer.

What a natural shine this gives! It is not glittery, it's just a glow from within shine. I use it as a skincare prep but also use it as a highlighter on my cheeks so it gives me a natural glow. Got as free product but my review is my honest opinion.

I got the product e.l.f.'s Glass Slick Serum Stick for free in exchange for writing the review. I was excited to try as I have used a few glass skin product from other K-beauty brands. This holds up just as well as the other products. I used to counter what some of my medicated products for my acne prone skin that dry my skin. It works lovely not too shiny and gives a soft dewy presence to my skin. I used this under makeup and over and the results for both were very noticeable and I will continue to keep apart of my makeup routine.

I have been trying the serum stick for the ast week and I am not a fan. It says it does not clog pores so it should be good for many skin types but each time I have used it, my acne has flared up. I have tried it under my makeup and it made my oase look weird where I applied it. I also tried it overtop of my makeup at the higr points on my tace and it iust makes the makeup there melt off hours quicker than the rest of my face. I think this product is just not for me.Product received as part of an educational promotion.

I have been trying the serum stick for the last week and I am not a fan. It says it does not clog pores so it should be good for many skin types but each time I have used it, my acne has flared up. I have tried it under my makeup and it made my base look weird where I applied it. I also tried it overtop of my makeup at the high points on my face and it just makes the makeup there melt off hours quicker than the rest of my face. I think this product is just not for me.

I love this product so much. I like that I can keep my hands mess free and just apply straight from the applicator. It makes my skin literally glow and gives me a fresh dewy look. My skin has never looked so good.

avis.titre: The amazing Glass Slick Stick Serum by "Elf"
avis.texte: This product helps with the end result of how my makeup turns out which is a smooth finish. The serum stick has plumped my skin and hydrates and doesn't leave a white cast nor greasiness. Overall, I've had nothing but a good experience with this glass.Slick serum stick I highly recommend.

I was given this product as part of a trial campaign. I love the application method, the stick makes it easy and less messy. The serum is excellent light weight but extremely moisturizing. It works well with or without makeup. I definitely will keep using this product.

I received this product as part of a promotion. I truly did love the glow it gave my cheeks and high points on my face! I will say at first when I was using it, I thought it felt a little greasy but my skin adjusted as it was on. Will use as part of my everyday makeup routine.

The formula is super lightweight—it literally feels like a refreshing splash of water when you glide it on your skin. It gives you that gorgeous, plump, juicy "glass skin" finish instantly without any of the stickiness. I've been using it in the morning on my bare skin days, and it just makes me look naturally bright and wide awake. My favorite way to use it, though, is mid-day over my makeup. Whenever my skin starts looking a bit flat or dry at the office, I just pat a little bit onto the high points of my cheeks. It revives my makeup instantly! If you want a quick shortcut to bouncy, glowing skin, you definitely need to try this. It has officially earned a permanent spot in my routine! I graciously received this product from Elf in exchange for this review.

avis.titre: Great Glassy stick for dry skin
avis.texte: I haven't used this regularly since I got it, so I can't comment on the look of my skin overtime when I use it, but I will say it gives the glass skin effect right away. Right now with it being summer my skin is oiler, but I think this would be perfect for winter.

I've really been enjoying the e.l.f. Glass Slick Serum Stick. The stick format makes it super convenient to apply, and it glides onto my skin without feeling sticky or heavy. It gives my skin an instant dewy glow that looks fresh and healthy instead of greasy. Thank you to e.l.f. Cosmetics for sending me this product for free in exchange for my honest review! I've used it both on bare skin and over makeup, and it works well either way. It adds a nice boost of hydration and leaves my skin looking smoother throughout the day. I also like that it's compact enough to throw in my bag for quick touch-ups. Overall, it's a simple product that delivers a natural glass-skin look at an affordable price. I'd definitely keep using it and would recommend it to anyone looking for an easy way to add hydration and glow!
So glowy! I really love it. I think I would like it even more in the winter months, I'm a little oily during the heat in the summer. But it makes my skin look glowy and feel super hydrated.
I received this product complementary for my review. I think the product is very nice, the texture feels great. It is a little too shimmery for my liking, but I like a natural look.

I was given the e.l.f. SKIN Glass Slick Serum Stick to try for free from e.l.f. SKIN, and I've been really impressed with it! It's incredibly easy to apply and gives my skin a fresh, healthy-looking glow without feeling greasy or heavy. The stick format is convenient for quick touch-ups throughout the day, and it glides on smoothly without disturbing my makeup. I love how it adds a dewy, glass-skin finish while also feeling nourishing on my skin. It leaves my complexion looking hydrated and radiant, especially on the high points of my face. The formula feels lightweight, comfortable, and perfect for achieving a natural glow. Overall, this is a great addition to my skincare and beauty routine. If you're looking for an easy way to boost hydration and get a luminous, healthy-looking finish, I would definitely recommend giving the e.l.f. SKIN Glass Slick Serum Stick a try.

I have to say I was skeptical about trying this product. I have oily skin and I thought it would make me look too dewy. I only applied at night before bed and what I experienced was soft/smooth skin in the morning! It felt hydrated! I will continue to buy this product and share with friends and family how much I enjoyed it! The packaging is super cute and easy to use, glide on, pat in and off you go. *I got a free sample to try so I could review it.*

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. Initially, I was really confused I wasn't sure what the point was. What I knew is that the consistency was super soft and slick. I'm not sure what my major malfunction was, but I was having a hard time understanding how to use it effectively. I'm in my upper 40s and anything that will help plump up fine lines is welcome in this household. I very much prefer to use it either at night or first thing in the morning underneath my makeup or after I've washed it off. It glides on my face so smoothly. The slight iridescent glow is really quite beautiful. on freshly cleansed skin. I have also worn it a couple of times over top of my makeup. I used to love a matte finish for my foundation, but I'm learning that I'm falling in love with a dewy finish. This product is perfect for creating subtle Dewey patches. I prefer to dab it versus swiping it when I have makeup on already. The value of this product is pretty great. There are a number of different options for use. Show the stick some grace in the beginning and you'll fall into your stride.

I've been using this on my skin for a quick glow throughout the day, and I really like how easy it is to apply. The serum stick feels lightweight, adds a healthy dewy finish, and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or greasy. It layers well over my skincare or makeup and is perfect for touch-ups when my skin needs a little extra hydration.

Glow stick is the best way to name this product. This is dewy highlight without needed sparkle or extra serums. Touch this on your high points for a soft reflection that looks juicy, youthful, and natural. Easy to use, no irritation, and no strong scents. Perfect size for carrying in a purse to touch up too!
So this is my first time using serum stick and i absolutely loved it !! , it gives me a hydrated, moisturised, dewy look and its non greasy.

avis.titre: This is going to be my...
avis.texte: This is going to be my winter fave! It's the perfect way to add a little shine and restore moisture on the go. I need more!!

avis.titre: Great as skincare, ok as makeup.
avis.texte: I tried the serum as a base with my skincare and on top of my makeup as a finishing highlighter. I didnt love it as much on top of my makeup as it felt like it was lifting my makeup but I did apply it directly on top. Maybe using a brush would have been better. Then I tried it as a glowy base layer which I preferred. It adds some nice luminosity and definitely that glass look. Love the peptides and the stick application.

I received this product as a free sample from buzz agent to test it out. First off, I love elf products! I have so many, you just can't beat the price and the quality is awesome. I will say, this product feels quite dense going on. It makes an amazing serum for dry skin! I am planning on saving this stick for winter, when the moisture is sucked out of my skin. But for summer, I feel like this product is too heavy for my skin. I usually switch to a very light moisturizer during these humid months.

avis.titre: Does what it says it does
avis.texte: I received this product for free from BzzAgent in exchange for an honest review. The packaging for this item seems like it could withstand a trip in my makeup bag so immediate points for that. I've never used a product like this but wanted to try it to see if it needed a permanent place in my makeup routine. I have mature skin and this didn't settle into lines. I liked that it could be used on top of makeup. If you have greasy skin, this is not the product for you. If wanting a glasslike complexion is what you're wanting, this is definitely worth a try, especially at this price point.

I received the product complimentary for review by BzzAgent, but all opinions are my own. I really enjoyed the packaging. It brings a protective cap for the stick that makes me feel like it will not dry out. The shine is actually very nice on this, it's not too overdone, but more than subtle. I think the product description is very accurate, it leaves skin glossy with a hydrated finish. My skin is dry enough that this is not enough, but anyone who just needs a little moisture, this will work great for you to build to plump skin over time.

avis.titre: it's fine but the price is right
avis.texte: I wanted to love this so bad. I love the idea of being able to swipe on a serum during skincare routine. For better or worse it's thicker than i think I'd like. It feels very heavy on the skin. I've enjoyed using it on days when i feel dry and might enjoy this more during the colder months. I don't think i can wear it during the day during summer. And I can't imagine putting this on over makeup. Maybe MAYBE a tiny bit at the high points or tip of the nose. But it would definitely smear your makeup. It does give your skin a sort of glassy appearance but honestly i would only be able to wear this sparingly out and about. I received this product in exchange for an honest review.

I received this product and was skeptical. After using it for two weeks though i have noticed the skin on my face being smoother and softer. I am an older women in my 40's and struggle finding things that don't make my face oily. I am able to wear this anytime of the day and it doesn't look greasy which i love. I'm going to continue using this as i do feel it is helping me with hydration in my face. I highly recommend as it's affordable and a quick option.

Being using for a few days now and I'm in love I have combination skin so I using only on my dry areas and my face looks so healthy and glowing I also really like like that it comes in a stick form because I can use it anywhere without getting my fingers on it
This is the perfect product for getting that natural glass skin look! I love using this on my bare skin for a healthier and fresh look and over top of my makeup for a natural shine.

I received this product to try for free. At first I was skeptical about it. After a few days of my skin adjusting to the product my skin felt so soft and hydrated. It gives a glowy look and I really like it. I would repurchase.

avis.titre: Amazing for dry skin in terms for self, skincare and make...
avis.texte: I have severe dry skin and the serum has helped my skin feel and look better. Its hard wirh my dry skin to wear makeup because it either irritates or flakes because my dry skin. This serum stick has been a game change for me, my skin and my makeup
This product gives natural radiant glow. It's definitely giving glass like skin, the only thing I didn't like is that it doesn't last to long.
Ive had it for a couple weeks and i love it! My face is kind if dry and dull and this balm gives me a nice soft glow. Im always on the go so having this as a stick is nice and convenient.
I really enjoy this product. Love using it was the final touch on top of my makeup. I feel like you wont notice it a lot by the end of the day but it makes my face look so youthful and fresh!

I use this in the morning, at night, underneath my makeup, on top of my makeup on highlight points. It makes me skin really soft under my moisturizer or by itself. It isn't greasy or oily it makes my face feel plump. Haven't had any negative skin reactions with it, I also love it being a stick off a fun application. I wouldn't say it's life changing which is why I gave it 4/5.

I received this product as a gift and I LOVE IT. Gives you really bouncy and shiny feel without it being overly oily. basics for that glassy skin finish. Great for cold winters when you need that extra glow for hydrated look. Looks great under the makeup. Will definitely be purchasing in the future . I have normal to oily skin (oily t-zones) and it goes very well with my skin with prefect hydration.

avis.titre: Beautiful glassy glow, but requires a light hand!
avis.texte: I've been using the Glass Slick Serum Stick for a couple of weeks now, and overall, I'm really impressed. If you love that "glass skin" look, this product absolutely delivers. It gives the skin a gorgeous, dewy, and luminous finish that looks incredibly healthy and hydrated. ​The stick format makes it super convenient to just swipe on and go, and it feels very nourishing, like a solid serum. It works beautifully as a highlighting stick on the cheekbones or as a glowy base under light makeup. ​The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that it can feel a little heavy or slightly tacky if you apply too much. If you have oily or combination skin, you definitely want to use a light hand, otherwise, it can cross the line from "dewy" to "greasy." ​That being said, for dry skin or for achieving that perfect, trendy glass-skin glow, it's a fantastic product. Would recommend!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I love the idea of the product and the ease of a stick format for a serum! Although in practice it does fall short for me. It's nice to put on your high points for a beautiful glow on no makeup days, but as far as using it for skincare it didn't really do much for me. I overall enjoyed the product but it isn't something that I would add to my daily routine

avis.titre: If you're a dewy lover… this product is for you.
avis.texte: It was a great product easy glides on the skin and leave skin looking hydrated and nourished with it look oily or greasy.

I received this product for free and this is my honest review. I like the stick since it's easy to apply. It definitely leaves a dewy finish. It is hydrating and feels good to put on. Not sure if I really saw a difference in my skin but I don't have extremely dry skin to begin with.

I was given a chance to try the product out in exchange for my review. I tried it on my skin, and immediately it felt so soft! It didn't require too much rubbing or scraping on either - goes on smooth like butter! This would be convenient for traveling and not worry about spilling liquids! Love it!

This is a really nice product that helps hydrate my skin! It is easy to apply, has a smooth texture, and absorbs well. I appreciate that it's unscented. I'm planning on traveling with it since it's in stick form so very compact, won't leak, and is less messy!

avis.titre: Nice moisture but not a traditional serum
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this for a few weeks now and feel it applies well. The stick format makes it easy to target specific areas and it goes on smooth. It feels nice on my skin and appreciate that it is quick for in the go days. I don't feel it works as well as a 'serum' since it does feel a bit heavier and greasier on application. It does absorb well after a little but this has lead me to use it more on my 'no makeup' days or as part of my nighttime skincare routine.

First of all, I'm a male, and I received this product through BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. The finish is very natural. I have oily skin, so I was a bit hesitant to use it on my face at first, but it doesn't look sparkly or overly "feminine" at all — just a healthy, subtle glow. I actually found that it works really well on the body too. The stick format makes it super easy to apply on areas like the arms and chest. Especially in the summer, when you want that hydrated, glossy look without visible shimmer, this product does a great job.

I waa given the opportunity to try this stick out in exchange for my honest opinion. It took a few weeks of use but I finally feel like I can endorse this product they way it deserves. I will start off by saying I wouldn't say I have mature skin but my skin has seen some time and evidence of that has started to show. Mostly in the form of laugh lines, crows feet and other small fine lines. I have never been a fan of heavy moisturizers or serum so I was surprised I kind of liked that about this product. It has a heavier formula but what I found was that heavy mess allowed the product to stay in place throughout the day and that allowed it time for it to work its magic. I only used the stick on certain areas of my face, around my eyes, center of forehead and around my mouth. Given time to sink in and melt into my skin this product really payer off. Especially with the delicate skin around my eyes. My laugh lines and crows feet around my eyes have plumped up and reduced the appearance of my fine lines and wrinklses. Visibly my skin looks younger while makeup application has become a breeze without it settling in the lines and wrinkles around my eyes. I plan to continue use of this stick to see even more long term improvements. I have been a elf girl for many years now and with products like this I will continue to be an elf girl for many more to come.

I've been so impressed with the e.l.f. Glass Slick Serum Stick! It glides on effortlessly and instantly gives my skin a healthy, dewy glow without feeling sticky or greasy. I love how lightweight and hydrating it feels, and it layers beautifully under makeup or over it for a quick refresh. My skin looks smoother, plumper, and has that fresh "glass skin" finish. For the price, the quality is incredible—definitely one of my new favorite skincare products!
I live In The desert and this product kept my skin hydrated after my night routine. Easy to apply and wash off as well durable to last night and day.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I found the serum stick to give a nice illuminating finish to the skin that look great both under and on top of makeup. It apply nicely without feeling greasy or sticky but hydrated. Great product.

While I have a ton of serums, I've never used a serum stick before. I was concerned it might swear my tinted sunscreen all over or not provide the same effect, but I was proved wrong. As you can see, there's no residual color on the stick from applying directly to my face over my suncreen. It actually felt exactly like a serum going on my skin, but without the mess on my hands. It's also easier to travel with, less prone to leaking. My skin looked well hydrated and felt great after applying. I'd definitely use this product, as well as try out other sticks in the future. I'd love it if my tinted sunscreen came in a stick now (elta md); it leaves such a mess in my hand.

I have been using the Glass Slick Stick for the past two months and I can honestly report that it has changed my whole routine! I apply it after washing my face and putting on a layer of moisturizer. I apply once in the morning and once at night. My skin has never looked so glossy, firm, or plump!

I received this product for free for my honest opinion and let me tell you that it is a great product it's not thick on the skin and goes on smooth and you can see a difference instantly it's great would definitely recommend
I have been using this product for over 3 weeks and it is the perfect moisturizer. I have oily skin and does greater for my skin

avis.titre: This will be perfect for the summer look

My golden rule for new skincare? One product at a time. It's the only way to know if something will actually work with your routine. I'm so glad I tested the Elf Glass Slick Serum Stick because it's been a game-changer for my dry skin. It gives that perfect hydrated, glassy look without any issues, and honestly, it's been a lifesaver during this brutal heat wave.

The Glass Slick Serum has a very smooth formula and gives your face a glow. The product is lightweight and only takes a few minutes to melt into your skin. Even after it is dry to the touch, your face will still have a slightly wet look. I really like the application with the stick format. This has been the perfect addition to my morning routine, as it gives my skin a nice hydration boost before putting on makeup. I received this product for free through BzzAgent in exchange for writing this review and giving my honest opinion.

This stick was very easy to use. I liked that it had an extra little cap to keep the stick contained and you twist to raise and lower the stick. A few swipes on my cheeks and i was ready to go! i enjoyed this a pretty good amount! it went on smoothly and left no real residue. it sunk in fast. i tried it during skincare and for makeup prep. both ways worked great for me and the slight glow this gives is usually still noticeable with the way I do makeup (no matt products). i also tried it over makeup but it wasn't my favourite look on myself personally, felt weird and looked a little off but i do think it works for some people so its worth a try! It's a little hard to tell just how much use i can get out of this and whether it's worth the price but i really do enjoy it at the moment. (I received this for free in exchange for my honest review)
